_comment: Every line of text in the game. Dialogue values may be a list: one entry per page.
title.name: LANTERN OF ELDERMOOR
menu.empty: Nothing yet. Go and find something.
map.nomap: No map of this temple yet.
get.sword: You lift your master's blade. It is lighter than it looks.
Press A to swing. Hold A to gather a spin.
get.shield: An oak shield. Hold L and nothing gets past you.
get.lantern: The Little Lantern! Its flame does not go out.
Set it to B, X or Y, then press that button to light torches and burn webs.
get.feather: The Updraft Feather. Press its button to hop a gap.
get.bombs: Fen Bombs. Ten of them, and they crack more than rock.
get.bottle: An empty bottle. Something will want to live in it.
get.map: A map of the temple. Press Select to read it.
get.compass: The compass. Now you can feel where the chests are.
get.bigkey: The Great Key. One door in this temple will know it.
get.heart_piece: A piece of heart. Four make one whole.
get.heart_piece_full: A piece of heart - and that makes four! Your heart grows.
get.heart_container: A whole heart. You stand a little straighter.
get.shell: A seashell, far from any sea.
get.flame.temple1: The first Flame comes to your wick without a sound.
One of eight. The mist on the meadow thins a little.
Take it home to the Great Lantern.
door.locked: Locked. A small key would turn it.
door.bigkey: This lock is far too grand for a small key.
shop.title: WARES
shop.hello: Mind the lamp oil. Take what you can pay for.
shop.sold: You already have one of those.
sign.blank: The paint has run off this one.
sign.village: LAMPLIGHT VILLAGE - keep the wicks trimmed.
sign.north: NORTH: the meadow road. Mind the thistles.
sign.temple: TEMPLE OF THE FIRST FLAME. Closed by order of nobody at all.
sign.shop: WARES. Knock if the door sticks.
npc.elder.1: Wren. The Great Lantern has gone out - all eight flames taken.
Eight temples, eight thieves, eight flames. You are the only lamplighter left standing.
Take the north road. The first temple is past the meadow.
npc.elder.2: One flame home. Seven to go, and the mist knows it.
npc.shop.1: Sixty embers for the shield. Cut the grass, it pays.
npc.kid.1: I saw a thing in the long grass. It had TEETH.
npc.kid.2: You went in the temple? With that little lantern?
npc.fisher.1: Fish won't rise while the mist sits on the water.
npc.baker.1: Eat before you go. The temple does not do suppers.
npc.guard.1: Nobody goes up the north road at night. Nobody sensible.
npc.guard.2: You came back. That's one more than I expected.
npc.wren_home: Your own bed. It will still be here afterwards.
story.temple1.enter: Something far below is breathing warm air up the stairs.
story.temple1.miniboss: The floor cracks. Something with a jaw comes up through it.
bestiary.mote: A knot of leftover fire. Hops. Does not think.
bestiary.thistle: Hides in the long grass until you are close enough to regret it.
bestiary.crag: Armour on the front, temper at the back. Get behind it.
bestiary.wisp: Walls mean nothing to it. Neither does hurry.
bestiary.spitter: Rooted. Winds up before it spits, which is the only kind thing about it.
bestiary.burrow: Travels under the floor and comes up where you were standing.
bestiary.cinderjaw: It circles, it slams, and then it is stuck for a moment. That moment is yours.
bestiary.ashmaw: Shut, it is a wall. Light the four torches and it opens.
hint.lantern: Set the Lantern to a button in the ITEMS menu first.
warp.lit: The warp lantern takes your flame. You can come back to this one from the map.
sign.bramble: BRAMBLE HOLLOW. The thorns grow back by morning.
sign.glade: THE HOLLOW GLADE. Quiet, isn't it.
get.bracelet: The Power Bracelet. Stone feels like bread now.
Press A at a rock or a pot to lift it, and A again to throw it.
get.flame.temple2: The second Flame settles on your wick.
Two of eight. The thorns along the north road look thinner.
bestiary.thornjaw: It rolls, it stops, and for a moment it is only a rock.
bestiary.hollowking: Throw the temple back at it.
story.temple2.enter: Roots have got in through the roof. Something has been using them.
get.hookshot: The Fen Hookshot. Six tiles of chain and a very rude claw.
Fire it at a pillar to be pulled across whatever is in between.
get.bow: The Reedwood Bow, and thirty arrows.
Arrows reach switches, eyes and anything that will not come down.
get.flame.temple3: The third Flame comes up out of the water dry.
Three of eight. The tide is going back out.
get.flame.temple4: The fourth Flame. The glass hums as it leaves.
Four of eight. Half the Great Lantern is lit again.
bestiary.brinejaw: It comes in with the water and goes out with it.
bestiary.tideclaw: Its shell opens only when the chain is in it.
bestiary.sandjaw: It swims in the sand, which is worse than it sounds.
bestiary.glassmaw: Put an arrow in the eye that is open.
story.temple3.enter: The floor is wet and the walls are wetter.
story.temple4.enter: Sand runs between the stones here, a grain at a time.
get.fins: Tidewrack Fins. Deep water is only water now.
get.fire_boots: Cinderstep Boots. Lava is warm, and ice is temporary.
get.mirror_cloak: The Mirror Cloak. Hold its button and the world looks past you.
What is thrown at you comes back the way it came.
get.gauntlet: The Titan Gauntlet. The heavy blocks are not heavy any more.
get.whistle: The Whistle of Winds. Blow it anywhere and the lanterns answer.
whistle.nowarp: Nothing answers. Light a warp lantern first.
bestiary.sentinel: It only hurts what it can see. Put the cloak on.
bestiary.weedjaw: It waits where the water is deepest, which is everywhere here.
bestiary.drownking: Wait for the water to go out of it.
bestiary.slagjaw: Still half molten. Let it cool, then hit it.
bestiary.kilnmaw: The kiln has a door. Open it.
bestiary.glassking: It cannot see the cloak, and it hates that.
bestiary.stonejaw: It was a wall once and it has not forgiven anyone.
bestiary.titanmaw: The last of the eight, and the heaviest.
bestiary.thequiet: It is what is left when every lamp goes out.
story.temple5.enter: Everything down here has been underwater, and most of it still is.
story.temple6.enter: The air shimmers. The floor is warm through your boots.
story.temple7.enter: Every wall is a mirror, and every mirror is watching.
story.temple8.enter: Blocks the size of houses. Someone moved them once.
story.temple9.enter: The Great Lantern stands open and empty.
get.flame.temple5: The fifth Flame, wrung out and still burning.
get.flame.temple6: The sixth Flame. It barely notices you.
get.flame.temple7: The seventh Flame, and a hundred reflections of it.
get.flame.temple8: The eighth Flame. Every one of them is yours now.
Take them to the Great Lantern.
ending.short: The Quiet goes out like a wick pinched between two fingers.
Wren sets eight Flames back in the Great Lantern, one at a time, and the mist goes down off the meadow like a sheet being pulled off furniture.
Lamplight Village can see its own north road again.
Somewhere out in the Mistlands, something is still unlit.
ending.full: The Quiet goes out like a wick pinched between two fingers.

Wren sets eight Flames back in the Great Lantern, and this time there is nothing left in the dark to take them again: every shell is found, every heart is whole, every grotto on the island has had a lamplighter in it.
The mist does not retreat. It simply stops being there.
The elder says the Lantern has not burned this bright since before he was born, and then he says it twice more, to different people, with more detail each time.
Wren puts the little lantern back on its hook by the door, where it can be reached quickly.
sign.great_lantern: The door has eight sockets and no handle. Eight flames are missing from it.
sign.great_lantern_open: Eight flames burn in the door. It stands open.
quest.cat.hint: Mira's cat is on a roof somewhere in the village.
quest.cat.ask: My cat went up and will not come down. She is grey, with one white foot.
quest.cat.wait: Still up there? She answers to a whistle, not to shouting.
quest.cat.thanks: You carried her all the way down! Here, take this - I carved it myself.
quest.cat.done: She sleeps on my pillow now. She has not forgiven the roof.
quest.bread.hint: The baker needs the wheat sheaf from the meadow barn.
quest.bread.ask: No wheat, no bread. There is a sheaf still standing in the old barn east of here.
quest.bread.wait: The oven is hot and empty. Bring me that sheaf.
quest.bread.thanks: Flour at last. Take these embers, and the first loaf when it comes out.
quest.bread.done: Smell that? That is your loaf, more or less.
quest.lamp.hint: Light all four village lamps after dark.
quest.lamp.ask: Four lamps, and my knees are done. Light them after dark and the mist keeps its distance.
quest.lamp.wait: Three is not four. The mist counts better than you do.
quest.lamp.thanks: All four burning. The village sleeps easier, and so will you.
quest.lamp.done: You still light them sometimes. I notice.
quest.broom.hint: Smash the five cracked pots behind the shop.
quest.broom.ask: Five cracked pots, all of them in my way. Break them and I will sweep the pieces.
quest.broom.wait: Some of them are still standing. I can see them from here.
quest.broom.thanks: Clean floor. Take the spare broom - it leans nicely in a corner.
quest.broom.done: The floor is clean. I have taken up complaining about the weather instead.
quest.letter.hint: Carry the sealed letter to the fisher in Saltmarsh.
quest.letter.ask: My sister lives out in the reeds. Carry this to her and do not read it.
quest.letter.wait: You still have it. She will be watching the water, as always.
quest.letter.thanks: She wrote back! Take the writing desk, I have two.
quest.letter.done: We write every month now. Thank you for the first one.
quest.shells5.hint: The shell hunter pays for seashells.
quest.shells5.ask: I am collecting shells. Bring me five and I will give you something lucky.
quest.shells5.wait: Five, not four. I can count.
quest.shells5.thanks: Five shells! Wear this ring - things turn up for people who wear it.
quest.shells5.done: Five was only the beginning, you know.
quest.shells20.hint: The shell hunter wants twenty seashells.
quest.shells20.ask: Twenty shells is a serious collection. I would trade something serious for it.
quest.shells20.wait: Keep looking. Under bushes, in caves, in the marsh.
quest.shells20.thanks: Twenty! Take this - it was my grandmother's, and it mends people.
quest.shells20.done: My shelf is the envy of the village.
quest.bestiary.hint: The scholar wants ten creatures in the bestiary.
quest.bestiary.ask: I write down what lives out there, but I will not go out there. Meet ten kinds for me.
quest.bestiary.wait: Ten kinds. You have met fewer. Go and be met.
quest.bestiary.thanks: Ten entries in my own hand. Take this figurine - it is a scholar, unsurprisingly.
quest.bestiary.done: Volume one is finished. There will be a volume two.
quest.sheep.hint: Three sheep wandered off the meadow road.
quest.sheep.ask: Three sheep, three directions. Walk them home and I will pay you properly.
quest.sheep.wait: One is still out. Probably eating something it should not.
quest.sheep.thanks: All three in the pen. Take the embers, they were going to be sheep anyway.
quest.flowers.hint: Pick the lanternflowers that grow by the old wall.
quest.flowers.ask: Lanternflowers only open at night, by the old wall. Bring me a handful.
quest.flowers.wait: They will have closed by morning. Go at night.
quest.flowers.thanks: They still glow. Take this little one - she is holding flowers too.
quest.flowers.done: They dried well. The whole room smells of them.
quest.bridge.hint: The carpenter needs a plank from the thornwood.
quest.bridge.ask: One plank short of a bridge. There is good wood lying in the thornwood.
quest.bridge.wait: Still one short. The river is not getting narrower.
quest.bridge.thanks: That will do it. Take this - I found it under the old bridge.
quest.bridge.done: Walk across any time. It holds.
quest.well.hint: Go down the meadow well and see what is making the noise.
quest.well.ask: Something down the well goes bump at night. I am too small to look.
quest.well.wait: Have you looked? It still goes bump.
quest.well.thanks: A frog! A very large frog. Here, this looks just like him.
quest.well.done: He lives in the horse trough now. He is happier.
quest.honey.hint: There is a honeycomb deep in the thornwood.
quest.honey.ask: Bramble honey is the best honey, and the brambles know it. Bring me a comb.
quest.honey.wait: No comb, no deal. Mind the thorns, and whatever lives in them.
quest.honey.thanks: Still warm. Take the shelf - you will want somewhere to put things.
quest.honey.done: I put half of it away for winter. Half.
quest.woodcutter.hint: Cut the brambles blocking the thornwood path.
quest.woodcutter.ask: The path is grown shut. You have a sword; I have a bad back.
quest.woodcutter.wait: Still grown shut in places. Keep cutting.
quest.woodcutter.thanks: A clean path. Here, this is what I would have paid a woodcutter.
quest.woodcutter.done: The cart gets through now. You saved me a winter.
quest.mushroom.hint: A pale mushroom grows where the thornwood is darkest.
quest.mushroom.ask: There is a pale mushroom that only grows in the dark part. I make medicine from it.
quest.mushroom.wait: Not yet? It grows where you would rather not stand.
quest.mushroom.thanks: Perfect. Take this bottle - I have no more use for a second one.
quest.mushroom.done: The medicine works. Do not ask what else is in it.
quest.net.hint: The fisher's net drifted off into the marsh.
quest.net.ask: My net went out with the tide. It is out there, caught on something.
quest.net.wait: Still out there. Look where the water goes quiet.
quest.net.thanks: Mended and hung. Take this fish - carved, so it keeps.
quest.net.done: The net brings in enough. Come and eat some time.
quest.tide.hint: A boat is stranded on the marsh flats.
quest.tide.ask: My boat sits on the mud waiting for a tide that will not come. Shift it for me.
quest.tide.wait: It has not moved. It will need more than shoulders.
quest.tide.thanks: Floating! Take this; I found it in the bilge years ago and never knew what it was.
quest.tide.done: She sails. Badly, but she sails.
quest.crab.hint: Meet fourteen kinds of creature for the marsh child.
quest.crab.ask: I want to know everything that lives in the reeds. And outside the reeds. Everything.
quest.crab.wait: Fourteen kinds. You are not finished.
quest.crab.thanks: Fourteen! Take this lamp, my uncle made two and nobody wanted the second.
quest.crab.done: I am going to write a book. A long one.
quest.gull.hint: Bring the harbour watchman a loaf for his gulls.
quest.gull.ask: The gulls expect bread at noon. I have no bread. You see my difficulty.
quest.gull.wait: Still no bread. They are looking at me.
quest.gull.thanks: Noon is saved. Take the gull - carved by someone with more patience than me.
quest.gull.done: They come at noon and leave at one. Good birds.
quest.water.hint: The digger in the desert wants water from the tarn.
quest.water.ask: I would pay a great deal for cold water. Tarn water, not well water.
quest.water.wait: Warm water is no use to me. The tarn is cold all year.
quest.water.thanks: Cold. Properly cold. Take this; I dug it up and it is no use to a thirsty man.
quest.water.done: I ration it. One mouthful an hour.
quest.dig.hint: Score eight at the desert dig patch.
quest.dig.ask: Eight finds in one go and the patch is yours for the day. Nobody has done it.
quest.dig.wait: Eight. In one go. Try again.
quest.dig.thanks: Eight! Take the little shovel - it is a prize, not a tool.
quest.dig.done: The record stands in your name. I wrote it on the post.
quest.glass.hint: The glassblower needs white sand from the deep desert.
quest.glass.ask: White sand, not yellow. The yellow makes cloudy glass and cloudy tempers.
quest.glass.wait: Yellow sand, I see. White. From the deep part.
quest.glass.thanks: Look at that colour. Take the window - it is a window, you will find a wall.
quest.glass.done: Everything I blow this month will be yours in part.
quest.coal.hint: The smith wants coal from the cinder fields.
quest.coal.ask: Wood will not do what coal does. There is coal out in the cinder, if you can stand the heat.
quest.coal.wait: The fire is sulking. Bring the coal.
quest.coal.thanks: Now it roars. Take this ring - I made it on a good day.
quest.coal.done: Come back when your shield wants looking at.
quest.bellows.hint: The cinder forge's bellows need a new strap.
quest.bellows.ask: The bellows gasp instead of blowing. It wants a strap, and strong hands.
quest.bellows.wait: Still gasping. The strap goes round twice, not once.
quest.bellows.thanks: Listen to that. Take the small anvil; it is only decorative, which is why I kept it.
quest.bellows.done: Two hundred years of blowing left in it now.
quest.skates.hint: Cross the tarn's long ice without falling in.
quest.skates.ask: Nobody crosses the long ice. It carries you sideways. Try it.
quest.skates.wait: You went in, did you not. Everyone goes in.
quest.skates.thanks: Straight across! Take this - it is a skate, and useless, and I love it.
quest.skates.done: You hold the crossing. I hold the falling-in record.
quest.mirror.hint: Find a shard of the great mirror in the tarn.
quest.mirror.ask: The great mirror broke long ago. One piece is still out there, still looking back.
quest.mirror.wait: Not yet. It is cold where it lies, and it is watching.
quest.mirror.thanks: It knows you. Take the ring - what it does, you already understand.
quest.mirror.done: I keep the shard covered. It is politer that way.
quest.frogs.hint: Count the lantern frogs in the fen after dark.
quest.frogs.ask: There were nine lantern frogs. Count them tonight and tell me there are still nine.
quest.frogs.wait: You have not counted. They only light up after dark.
quest.frogs.thanks: Nine. Say it again. Nine. Take the little lantern, it was made the year I was born.
quest.frogs.done: Nine frogs, every night. The fen is as it should be.
quest.oil.hint: The fen lantern-keeper is out of oil.
quest.oil.ask: A lantern with no oil is a jar. There is oil in the fen, if you know which reeds.
quest.oil.wait: Still a jar. Look for the reeds that sweat.
quest.oil.thanks: Burning again. Take this - a keeper found it inside a lantern once.
quest.oil.done: The light reaches the far bank now.
quest.ghost.hint: The pale figure in the Mistlands asks where you have been.
quest.ghost.ask: You have not walked far enough to understand me. Walk the kingdom first.
quest.ghost.wait: There is more kingdom than that. Walk it.
quest.ghost.thanks: Now you have seen it. Take the bottle. It held something once, and will again.
quest.ghost.done: Go where you like. I have stopped waiting.
quest.quiet.hint: Meet twenty-two kinds of creature for the pale figure.
quest.quiet.ask: Name me everything that still lives here. Twenty-two kinds, by my count.
quest.quiet.wait: Not all of them. Something is still unnamed.
quest.quiet.thanks: All of them named. Take this ring; the kingdom mends slowly, and so should you.
quest.quiet.done: The list is complete. I will keep it for whoever comes next.
quest.item.wheat.desc: A sheaf from the old barn.
quest.item.letter.desc: Sealed, and none of your business.
quest.item.bread.desc: A fresh loaf. The gulls know.
quest.item.sand.desc: White, fine, from the deep desert.
token.refuse: It will not budge. Not by hand.
token.cat: The grey cat lets you pick her up. She is not sorry.
token.well: A frog the size of a loaf blinks at you, then follows you up.
token.net: The net is caught on a sunken post. You work it free.
token.boat: You set your shoulder to the hull and the mud lets go with a sigh.
token.bellows: You loop the strap round twice. The bellows take a deep breath.
token.ice: You come off the long ice standing up. Nobody saw it. You know.
token.sheep: One sheep, walked back to the road. It takes this personally.
token.pot: The pot goes to pieces, obligingly.
token.lamp: The lamp catches. The mist steps back a pace.
token.bramble: The brambles come away in armfuls. The path remembers itself.
token.frog: A lantern frog, lit up like a window. You count it.
bestiary.grub: A soft thing that eats light and runs from boots.
bestiary.shale: Sleeps as a stone until something walks past it.
bestiary.brinelet: Circles in the shallows and will not be hurried.
bestiary.dustmite: Too small to aim at. Comes in numbers.
bestiary.emberfly: Drifts until it notices you, then does not drift.
bestiary.glimmer: Looks like a lamp. Shoots like a sentinel.
bestiary.reedsnap: A mouth that pretends to be a reed.
bestiary.stonehand: Slow, heavy, and in no hurry to stop.
bestiary.mistling: Only the lantern shows where it is.
bestiary.cinderworm: Burrows through hot ground and spits what it finds.
story.grotto.enter: Roots hold the roof up. Something has been chewing them.
story.tidecave.enter: The tide comes in twice a day and leaves less than it brought.
story.vent.enter: Hot air from somewhere below. The walls tick as they cool.
story.tarnhollow.enter: Ice above and below, and a draught from the dark end.
story.burrow.enter: Sand has run through here for centuries and polished it.
story.warren.enter: The mist comes indoors here. It knows the way.
bestiary.huskjaw: A root-eater with a shell like bark.
bestiary.clamjaw: Shuts when you look at it. Opens when you do not.
bestiary.slagpup: Young, molten and delighted about it.
bestiary.frostpup: It breathes and the air stops moving.
bestiary.glasspup: Polished smooth. Nothing sticks to it.
bestiary.mistpup: You hear it long before the lantern finds it.
get.ring: A ring! Slip it on from the RINGS page.
get.figurine: A figurine. It goes on the shelf with the others.
get.furniture: Furniture. Someone will carry it home for you.
npc.gallery.1: Every figurine in the kingdom passes through here eventually.
npc.market.1: Second-hand, mostly. Third-hand, some of it. All of it solid.
shop.gallery: Have a look. Carved, cast or whittled, I take them all.
shop.market: Furniture, and one ring I was talked into. Make me an offer of exactly the price.
trade.0.ask: Take these reeds. Somebody down the marsh weaves with them.
trade.0.take: Reeds! I have been waiting on reeds. Take this basket in exchange.
trade.0.done: The reeds went into a basket, and the basket went walking.
trade.1.ask: A basket is no use to me without something to put in it.
trade.1.take: That is a good basket. Here, take the fish I cannot carry.
trade.1.done: I keep my pegs in a basket now. Civilised.
trade.2.ask: A fish? I will swap you - take my knife, I have two.
trade.2.take: A fish for a knife is a fair trade in any weather.
trade.2.done: I ate the fish. It was a good fish.
trade.3.ask: I have been cutting pastry with a spoon. Give me that knife.
trade.3.take: A knife! Take a pie, straight out, mind the steam.
trade.3.done: Everything I cut, I cut with that knife.
trade.4.ask: Is that a pie? I will trade you my whistle for it. It is a good whistle.
trade.4.take: A whole pie. Here, the whistle. It calls dogs, mostly.
trade.4.done: Best pie I ever had, and I have had two.
trade.5.ask: A whistle! My hound will not come when called. Lend it here.
trade.5.take: He came at the first blow. Take him - he likes you better anyway.
trade.5.done: He sits by the gate now and waits for you.
trade.6.ask: A hound out here is worth more than water. Take my sandglass.
trade.6.take: He will dig where I point. Take the sandglass, I know the hours by heart.
trade.6.done: He has learned the dig patch. He is better at it than I am.
trade.7.ask: A sandglass! The forge runs by guesswork. Take this coalstone.
trade.7.take: Now the heats are timed. Here, a coalstone - it burns for a week.
trade.7.done: Twelve minutes to a good weld. I know because of you.
trade.8.ask: Coal that burns a week? The tarn has no wood. Take the old lamp.
trade.8.take: Warm at last. Take the lamp; it has not been lit in years.
trade.8.done: The house is warm. I have stopped sleeping in my coat.
trade.9.ask: You carry an unlit lamp through the mist. Give it here.
trade.9.take: It lights. Of course it lights, now. Take this ring; walk quickly, and come back.
trade.9.done: The lamp burns at the edge of the mist. Somebody may see it.
game.gallery.hello: Ten embers a go. Three lanes, thirty seconds, no excuses.
game.dig.hello: Twenty embers and ten digs. Half the patch has something in it.
game.bells.hello: Fifteen embers. Ring the bell I call, before I stop calling it.
game.poor: Not enough embers, I am afraid.
shop.locked: That one is for a collector. Meet {n} kinds of creature first.
bestiary.veilmaw: It wears the mist like a coat and takes it off to hit you.
bestiary.duskmaw: The last thing the evening swallowed.
bestiary.merewarden: It kept something safe for so long it forgot what.
bestiary.palewarden: The quiet left a door, and this stands behind it.
story.mists.enter: The door was not here before. The mist has been keeping it.
bestiary.mistjaw: It guards a stair it does not understand.
rush.title: THE STANDING RING
rush.hello: Every one of them, one after another, and no way out but through.
rush.over: That is as far as it goes. The ring lets you out.
npc.rush.1: You have saved the kingdom. Would you like to do the hard part again, all at once?
npc.rush.ask: The ring is open. Walk in when you are ready.
master.hello: The kingdom remembers you, and it has been practising.
